observations: Three photos show what appears to be a Konica Minolta color multifunction printer/copier, wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand name 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model text 'bizhub C3351' are visible on the front panel in photo 0 and photo 2.
Photo 1 shows the side/front of a similar unit with 'bizhub C33...' partially visible, in the same style shelving.
Various unrelated promotional flyers (a bird picture, 'Dumei Engineering Clinic', 'Oslee Pub') are taped to the front panels in each photo.
Units sit on a wooden shelf/pallet within what looks like a secondhand equipment warehouse, stacked close to other machines.
No photo shows the control panel powered on, no page-counter display, no toner-level gauge, and no rear/side view showing all paper trays or ports.
The unit looks visually intact (no dents or cracks visible) but most of the body is obscured by plastic wrap and stickers.

claims.evidence: Brand and model text clearly visible on front panel in photo 0 and photo 2
Model is known as an A4 colour MFP, but no photo shows it powered on, printing, or scanning to confirm all-in-one functions work
Marketing language, not a checkable fact

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may throw error codes (common in used copiers)
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit powering on, screen showing home menu, and a test print/copy coming out

risks.risk: High page/meter count shortens remaining toner drum and fuser life, affecting value
risks.proof: Photo of the on-screen counter/meter menu showing total page count

risks.risk: Toner and drum units may be empty, expired, or non-OEM, which is costly to replace on this model
risks.proof: Photo of open toner/drum compartment showing cartridge levels and OEM labels
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Missing trays, finisher, network card, or other accessories reduce functionality
risks.proof: Full 360° photos showing all paper trays, rear ports, and any attached finisher
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no extras

risks.risk: Physical condition (scratches, cracked panels, broken hinges) hidden under plastic wrap and flyers
risks.proof: Photos with wrap and stickers removed, showing full front, sides, and interior
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, worst visible case

risks.risk: Possible unit mix-up: three photos may show different physical units of the same model rather than one specific item for sale
risks.proof: Seller confirms and photographs the single unit being sold, with a matching serial number sticker visible in all shots
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-condition unit among those shown

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and producing a test colour copy/print
Photo of the control panel's page counter/meter screen
Photo of the toner and drum compartments open, showing levels and brand
Full exterior photos with plastic wrap and flyers removed, including rear and all paper trays
Photo of the serial number plate matching across all three listed units
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photos, but no evidence shows the unit powered on, its page count, or consumable levels, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-working used copier pending the listed proofs.
